messages:
anya: Quick proposal — small 'pin-sanity' preflight that runs in CI and as a deploy-bot check. Idea: verify pinned artifact exists, suggest a compatible fallback when appropriate, and emit a one-line release-note snippet.

anya: Example local command: `./tools/pin-check --model=llama-13b --pin=v2026-03-15` — returns OK / WARNING with suggested fallback.

matt: Sounds useful. Keep it super fast so the deploy flow doesn't stall. :+1:

anya: Plan is to read manifests/pins.yaml, validate against model-registry API, and check that the pinned artifact digest is present on storage. If mismatch -> WARNING + suggested fallback mapping.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight hook registered: pin-sanity -> release.create

sam: Can we also have it generate a release-note line? Example suggestion: `model: llama-13b @ v2026-03-15 — q4_0 quant, perf stable, -12% cost` — that'd save copy/paste.

kevin: Love that idea. Where would the template live?

anya: Minimal template example below (will be rendered YAML -> text):
```
- Component: inference
  Change: pin llama-13b -> v2026-03-15
  Reason: perf stability + cost-reduction
  Rollback: pin v2026-02-28
```
Usage: `tools/mk-release-note --from-pin manifests/pins.yaml --model llama-13b` -> single-line summary.

matt: Escape-hatch behaviour?

anya: Behaviour design: preflight fail -> deploy-bot comments in release thread with `WARNING: pin-sanity failed` and `Suggested fallback: llama-13b -> v2026-02-28`. Deploy blocked unless one of: (a) `--override` with explicit `@release-ops` ack, or (b) deploy to `canary` environment only.

sam: I'll take the PR for the checker + release-note generator. I'll include a small model-registry mock for integration tests.

kevin: Please add a README under tools/pin-check/ showing examples and a `deployctl` snippet to wire the hook: `deployctl preflight add pin-sanity --hook ./tools/pin-check`.

matt: Ping me when PR is opened; I'll run it in staging flow and exercise the override paths. :eyes:

anya: Thanks — assigning to @sam. I'll follow up to add the deploy-bot integration and the comment templates.

deploy-bot: [automated] Created preflight-hook entry for pin-sanity; results will be posted to release threads and the release checklist.
